title: SecureDrive-FL: Joint Differential Privacy and Gradient-Aware Selective Homomorphic Encryption for Federated Driver Monitoring
abstract: arXiv:2608.27108v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables privacy-aware distributed training, yet gradient updates remain exploitable: Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) interception exposes updates in transit, while model poisoning corrupts global convergence. We first introduce GASHE (Gradient-Aware Selective Homomorphic Encryption), a novel selective encryption strategy that dynamically identifies and encrypts only the gradient components exceeding a DP-calibrated sensitivity threshold, rather than encrypting all parameters uniformly as in static layer-based or full-parameter CKKS schemes. Building on GASHE, we introduce SecureDrive-FL, a federated driver monitoring framework that couples DP-SGD with GASHE to create the first closed-loop DP+HE privacy pipeline: DP-SGD calibration parameters directly derive the GASHE encryption mask, unifying training-time privacy and communication-time confidentiality. Evaluated on a ten-class distracted driver classification task und

translated_title: SecureDrive-FL：联合差分隐私与梯度感知选择性同态加密的联邦驾驶员监控
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）支持隐私感知的分布式训练，但梯度更新仍可被利用：中间人（MitM）拦截会暴露传输中的更新，而模型投毒会破坏全局收敛。我们首先引入GASHE（梯度感知选择性同态加密），这是一种新颖的选择性加密策略，它动态识别并仅加密超过差分隐私校准灵敏度阈值的梯度分量，而不是像静态基于层或全参数CKKS方案那样均匀加密所有参数。基于GASHE，我们提出SecureDrive-FL，一个联邦驾驶员监控框架，将DP-SGD与GASHE结合，创建了首个闭环DP+HE隐私流水线：DP-SGD校准参数直接推导出GASHE加密掩码，统一了训练时隐私和通信时机密性。在十类分心驾驶员分类任务上评估，该方案实现了...
tldr: 本文提出了SecureDrive-FL框架，通过梯度感知选择性同态加密（GASHE）与DP-SGD的闭环集成，首次实现了仅加密关键梯度分量的高效隐私保护联邦驾驶员监控，同时抵御中间人攻击和模型投毒。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SecureDrive-FL, which integrates gradient-aware selective homomorphic encryption (GASHE) with DP-SGD in a closed-loop pipeline, enabling efficient privacy-preserving federated driver monitoring by encrypting only critical gradient components while defending against MitM attacks and model poisoning.
